verses.html: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.
verses.text: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.

verses.html: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.
verses.text: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.

verses.html: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD'S name is to be praised.
verses.text: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD'S name is to be praised.

verses.html: The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
verses.text: The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.

verses.html: Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,
verses.text: Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,

verses.html: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!
verses.text: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!

verses.html: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
verses.text: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

verses.html: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
verses.text: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

verses.html: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.
